title: 前副国安顾问Mara Rutman：内塔尼亚胡处境艰难，特朗普言论不可靠
speaker: Mara Rutman

segments.en: Mara, do you think Israel will cooperate in the 60 day period in terms of not attacking Lebanon?
segments.zh: Mara，你认为以色列会在60天内合作，不攻击黎巴嫩吗？

segments.en: Yeah, Prime Minister Netanyahu is in a very difficult position. It's been described throughout the media something of a voice in the what he needs from the United States regardless of what he says.
segments.zh: 是的，内塔尼亚胡总理处境非常艰难。媒体一直描述他需要美国，无论他说什么

segments.en: Israel obviously a fair amount of their weaponry comes from the United States, not not quite the amounts that the Vice President spoke of in the interviews he's had but a good degree of their military ability is enhanced their military strength by the cooperation with the United States
segments.zh: 以色列相当一部分武器来自美国，虽然不完全是副总统在采访中说的数量，但他们的军事能力很大程度上通过与美国的合作得到增强

segments.en: and he recognizes that he also as a politician has sold himself on his incredibly close relationship with President Trump and Israel of course is going into elections in September, October.
segments.zh: 他认识到这一点，作为政治家，他标榜自己与特朗普总统关系非常密切，而以色列将在9月、10月举行选举

segments.en: Prime Minister Netanyahu is not pulling well at this point and so he personally isn't a very difficult position and he's not had the best relationship with his military now for an extended period of time really since before October 7th
segments.zh: 内塔尼亚胡总理目前支持率不高，他个人处境艰难，而且与军方关系不佳，实际上自10月7日之前就已如此

segments.en: so so he's in a difficult position. I think it's pretty impossible to predict what he will do and what he will order his military to do.
segments.zh: 所以他处境艰难。我认为几乎不可能预测他会做什么，以及他会命令军队做什么

segments.en: Mara, President Trump says the Strait of Ramos has reopened but we've heard many guests on this program that say it's not like turning on the lightswitch right in terms of reviving those energy flows again.
segments.zh: Mara，特朗普总统说霍尔木兹海峡已重新开放，但我们节目中的许多嘉宾表示，恢复能源流动不像打开电灯开关那么简单

segments.en: What's the advice to a shipping company or an insurer right now? Do you think we've seen enough for them to confidently send vessels to the waterway again?
segments.zh: 现在对航运公司或保险公司有什么建议？你认为我们看到足够多的迹象让他们有信心再次派船通过该水道吗？
